tagline: Make a motion-capture workflow understandable from capture to export.
introduction: A creative technical companion for Rokoko's public motion-capture and animation workflows, helping plan inputs, retargeting and verification.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Rokoko? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Map a capture pipeline
capabilities.description: Describe the stages from a chosen capture input to animation delivery.

capabilities.title: Review retargeting symptoms
capabilities.description: Organize supplied symptoms into likely retargeting questions.

capabilities.title: Prepare a capture session
capabilities.description: Plan a small capture session and evidence needed for later debugging.

starterPrompts: Help plan a Rokoko motion-capture workflow for a short character animation, from capture to export.
My retargeted character's feet slide. What measurements and setup details should I inspect first?
Create a capture checklist for a short demo with repeatable calibration and export checks.
